title: Pig dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- background/glow ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="30" ry="5" fill="#2A1A3A"/>
  
  <!-- back leg (left) -->
  <rect x="30" y="68" width="12" height="18" rx="5" fill="#E88AAE" transform="rotate(-15 36 77)"/>
  <!-- back hoof -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="86" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#B8557A" transform="rotate(-15 28 86)"/>
  
  <!-- back leg (right) -->
  <rect x="58" y="68" width="12" height="18" rx="5" fill="#F0A0C0" transform="rotate(20 64 77)"/>
  <!-- back hoof -->
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="86" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#C86A90" transform="rotate(20 74 86)"/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="24" ry="18" fill="#F4A7C3"/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="63" rx="15" ry="10" fill="#FCD6E4"/>
  
  <!-- curly tail -->
  <path d="M74 52 Q82 46 80 40 Q78 36 74 38 Q71 40 73 44" fill="none" stroke="#E88AAE" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- front arm (left) waving up -->
  <rect x="22" y="42" width="10" height="20" rx="5" fill="#F0A0C0" transform="rotate(35 27 52)"/>
  <!-- front hoof left -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="40" r="6" fill="#C86A90"/>
  
  <!-- front arm (right) swinging back -->
  <rect x="68" y="46" width="10" height="20" rx="5" fill="#E88AAE" transform="rotate(-30 73 56)"/>
  <!-- front hoof right -->
  <circle cx="82" cy="42" r="6" fill="#B8557A"/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="34" r="20" fill="#F4A7C3"/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="32" r="15" fill="#FCD6E4"/>
  
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="18" rx="8" ry="10" fill="#E88AAE" transform="rotate(-20 34 18)"/>
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="19" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#FCD6E4" transform="rotate(-20 34 19)"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="18" rx="8" ry="10" fill="#E88AAE" transform="rotate(20 66 18)"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="19" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#FCD6E4" transform="rotate(20 66 19)"/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="32" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#4A2040"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="30" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="32" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#4A2040"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="30" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="40" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#F070A0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="40" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#F070A0" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#E88AAE"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#E88AAE"/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="42" rx="1.8" ry="2.2" fill="#B8557A"/>
  <ellipse cx="53" cy="42" rx="1.8" ry="2.2" fill="#B8557A"/>
  
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 47 Q50 52 56 47" fill="none" stroke="#B8557A" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- dance sparkles -->
  <path d="M18 24 L20 28 L24 29 L20 30 L18 34 L16 30 L12 29 L16 28 Z" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <path d="M82 20 L84 24 L88 25 L84 26 L82 30 L80 26 L76 25 L80 24 Z" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <path d="M14 52 L15 55 L18 56 L15 57 L14 60 L13 57 L10 56 L13 55 Z" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="54" r="2.5" fill="#FFE066"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="38" r="2" fill="#FFE066"/>
</svg>
